name: 导演
heroHeadline: 每一个镜头都在构建世界
heroSubtitle: 导演 · 叙事 · 电影语言
personalStatement: 电影是时间的雕塑。作为导演，我的工作是找到那个唯一的视角——让观众看见我一直看见却从未说出口的东西。
personalStatementEn: Film is sculpture in time. As a director, my job is to find that singular perspective — letting the audience see what I've always seen but never said.
